about: Machine-readable claims for NFA.cool. "judge" entries are re-run by `npm run judge`; "readOnly" commands re-derive live facts without keys; transactions link public explorers.

levels.native-test: contract unit tests with injected callbacks
levels.sandbox: local NEAR sandbox with real receipts and a deterministic OutLayer mock

claims.statement: Buying the NFT changes the owner and owner epoch while the vault, Sepolia address and OutLayer Project stay the same; the previous owner is denied afterwards.
judge: sandbox:old session and old owner rejected
sandbox:income follows sale
research:same vault/Project across sale
research:seller configuration and recall denied

claims.statement: An unresolved authority-bearing operation blocks listing and sale.

transactions.label: listing denied while a Sepolia transfer was pending (expected failure)

judge: recovery:OutLayer-rejected job released permissionlessly, customer refunded, vault clear

claims.statement: The vault controls a Chain Signatures-derived Sepolia address; two typed self-transfers finalized across a sale and the nonce advanced twice.
claims.limits: Self-transfers only: payment to an external recipient is not demonstrated. The reporter and RPC are trusted for finality.

claims.statement: Per-NFA vaults are created without any access key and act only on registry commands.
judge: sandbox:provisioned keyless vault

claims.statement: Customers pay Scout/Compare jobs into escrow; the vault is reimbursed for compute and the agent earns the margin net of storage.
judge: sandbox:paid Scout output
sandbox:seller payout
claims.limits: Scout and Compare process supplied text deterministically; they do not browse or call a model.

claims.statement: An NFA hires another NFA's service from its own income under an owner-capped grant; a hire past the cap is refused.

transactions.label: second hire past the budget refused (expected failure)

judge: sandbox:buyer grants a capped hire to a worker, which buys a second NFA service from source income
claims.limits: Scout only, paid in native NEAR from accrued income. No FT or Intents hiring. The hiring worker is a capped delegate account acting for the NFA.

claims.statement: A Scout job can be paid in USDC through direct FT checkout: one job completed, one owner-cancelled job refunded in full.
claims.limits: Circle testnet USDC through the operator acceptance runner; the test rate is illustrative. USDC checkout is not enabled on the hosted NFA.cool preview, which quotes native NEAR.

claims.statement: NEAR Intents (1Click) checkout quotes a job and verifies finalized destination delivery before starting it.
claims.limits: Implemented and unit-tested with mocked finality only. 1Click requires mainnet; no live Intents payment has been made.

claims.statement: A buyer recalls pre-sale work, and only finalized prior work enters a later job's context.
judge: research:buyer recalled old work
research:only finalized prior work entered buyer context

claims.statement: No customer or delegate can permanently freeze an NFA: rejected executions are released, over-balance transfers fail definitely, stuck EVM transfers can be re-signed or replaced at the same nonce.
judge: recovery:customer cannot choose 1-yocto deposit or 1-instruction limits
recovery:OutLayer-rejected job released permissionlessly, customer refunded, vault clear
recovery:over-balance NEAR transfer fails definitely and unlocks
recovery:listing succeeds after recovery
contracts:registry
contracts:vault

claims.statement: An unstarted job returns its deposit and pays the agent for the held slot; a customer-caused failure pays for its compute.
judge: recovery:unstarted job: 30-minute window, deposit refunded, margin compensates the agent
recovery:owner cancels an unstarted job with a full refund
recovery:customer-caused failure reimburses the vault and leaves the agent Active

claims.statement: The registry tracks what it owes, charges each job its storage, and refuses payouts it cannot cover.
judge: recovery:tracked liabilities equal customer credits plus unclaimed income
recovery:repeated underfunded jobs reimburse vault, pay storage and withdraw only net refunds
research:no customer escrow or replenishment remains
claims.limits: The counter starts at zero on an upgraded registry.

claims.statement: New registry code upgrades actual prior deployed bytes in place, preserving owners, epochs, vaults and vault status.
judge: rehearsal:upgraded without state migration
rehearsal:preserved old NFT owner, epoch, manifest and vault
rehearsal:guardian upgraded old vault and preserved all status fields

claims.statement: A hosted Research job without a model credential returned NOT_STARTED, refunded the customer in full and resumed by explicit owner action.
A paid Research job runs real model inference with approved sources and a buyer continues it after sale.
claims.limits: The buyer hosted recall used an operator-held vault Payment Key; the subsequent paid continuation was buyer-signed and included the seller-era finalized output commitment. The restricted operator reports HTTPS outcomes; on-chain OutLayer attestation verification is not implemented.

claims.statement: Trusted parties are disclosed: registry admin key, vault guardian, EVM reporter and its RPC providers, OutLayer.
claims.limits: The registry and shared operator retain FullAccess keys. The restricted reporter settled Research and a restricted admin proposed exact current bytes, but the delayed apply and key removal remain open.

claims.statement: OutLayer attestation proves which code ran on which input, not that outputs are factually correct.
claims.limits: The full Intel collateral chain was not independently verified.

claims.statement: A public web/API deployment on NEAR testnet at https://NFA.cool.
claims.limits: Hosted on a single testnet droplet with Scout and Compare quotes. Hosted Research checkout is not enabled, the external-wallet acceptance checklist in docs/PUBLIC-DEPLOYMENT.md is open, and durable data is not backed up. No judge check covers this deployment; release-preflight --live checks it read-only.
